create_induction.coil.wired: Wired into a Power Grid circuit
create_induction.coil.wired.no_fe: Makes no Forge Energy while a wire is attached
create_induction.coil.wired.open: Nothing on the circuit is drawing power
create_induction.bearing.title: Rotor:
A magnet that is _always on_. Attracts and repels _Redstone Magnets_ and induces current in _Induction Coils_ it moves past. The red face is north.
block.create_induction.induction_coil.to: Makes _electricity_ from magnets moving past its face, braking them as it does. Given a _redstone signal_ it spends energy to become an _electromagnet_.
block.create_induction.dynamo_bearing.to: Spins the structure on its face as a _physics rotor_ using rotational force from behind. Costs _stress for the work it does_: the harder the rotor is braked, the more it draws.
block.create_induction.commutator.toolti: A _Slip Ring cut into segments_. Touching a Slip Ring across a turning joint, it powers the _coils attached to it_ and reverses each one as it turns, making them a _motor_. Set the number of _magnet poles_ around it; a negative number reverses it.
create_induction.commutator.title: Commutator:
create_induction.slip_ring.title: Slip Ring:
block.create_induction.slip_ring.tooltip: Carries _electricity across a turning joint_. Place one on the moving structure and one facing it on the fixed side; whatever energy is fed into either comes out of the other.
